data.long_meaning: Shaileshkumar is a name of Hindu origin which means 'Mountain Lord'. This name is derived from two Sanskrit words 'Shailesh' which means mountain and 'Kumar' which means young boy or prince. The name Shaileshkumar carries the meaning “Mountain Lord” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shaileshkumar usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
